scope: Proposition 9.5 of the manuscript “Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level” (preprints/Global-quantum-geometric-Langlands-at-irrational-level-October-4-2026/quantum-langlands.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 069 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d9bc135865dbc97), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a canonical comparison G0 ≃ G1, where G0(A, B) = FV ins A, ins(α̌U B)  , G1(A, B) = F̌V ins B, ins(αT A)  . (9.5) It agrees with the disjoint comparison and respects D(S)-linearity, coordinate changes, disjoint products, symmetries, and all diagonal operations for merge and repetition of marks. Vacua give the empty inputs. In particular, (9.4) is compatible with ordinary insertion of marks.
